$comment: Intl formatters built inside a function body in the browser app (scripts/intl-scan.mjs, #4612 slice 5). Per file, per constructor: how many call sites and why. Only shrinks — a lower count in the code fails until it is lowered here. src/ lists none and must stay that way: on the server a formatter per call is how Pulse OOM-killed production.

Intl.DateTimeFormat().why: marketToday builds one per call; a tab calls it a few times per render, never per sample
localSessionSuffix takes the viewer's zone as an argument, so the shape is not a constant
easternParts is a fixed shape that could be hoisted; a tab calls it once per tick

Intl.NumberFormat().why: contractsText is a fixed shape that could be hoisted; a tab formats a handful of counts
